definitions.explanation: The year two years ago from the current year.

examples.japanese: おととし{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to Japan the year before last.

examples.japanese: おととしの{夏|なつ}は{暑|あつ}かった。
examples.english: The summer of the year before last was hot.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はおととし{大学|だいがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}した。
examples.english: He graduated from university the year before last.

notes:
おととし means two years ago.

TIME SEQUENCE:
- おととし (year before last)
- {去年|きょねん}/{昨年|さくねん} (last year)
- {今年|ことし} (this year)
- {来年|らいねん} (next year)
- {再来年|さらいねん} (year after next)

ALTERNATE FORM:
- {一昨年|いっさくねん}/{一昨年|おととし} (formal written form)
